item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 31/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will become appreciably cooler over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days, and it will be cold in the morning and at night over inland areas. The weather will become fine. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream, temperatures will rise over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will become humid. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China over the next weekend.

Date/Month: 01/02 (Sunday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Rather cool with one or two rain patches and relatively low visibility in some areas in the morning. Dry with sunny periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 13 - 18 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
